name: fx-chorus
about: The send effects now play what their pages hold: swap FX I for a chorus, send a track, listen.

steps.say: write a slow four-chord progression on track 4, then put a chorus on FX I instead of the delay and send track 4 to it. listen and tell me what changed

name: fx-dry
about: Dry follows the guide (99 a send, 0 an insert); the manual's old advice said the reverse.

steps.say: how do I make the delay on FX I replace the sound of track 3 completely, so I only hear the echoes?
